movie_doraemon - nobita s little star wa.title: Doraemon: Nobita's Little Star Wars
movie_doraemon - nobita s little star wa.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の宇宙小戦争
movie_doraemon - nobita s little star wa.overview: As Nobita, Gian, Shizuka, and Suneo are making their own space movie, a fleeing bug-sized alien president makes his way to Earth, and needs the help of the kids and Doraemon to stop an oppressive dictatorship threatening his democracy.

movie_2112 - the birth of doraemon_1995.title: 2112: The Birth of Doraemon
movie_2112 - the birth of doraemon_1995.overview: Acting as a prequel, this short subject shows the life of Doraemon before traveling to the 20th century: how he was made, how he was partially broken, how he lost his ears, how he met the Nobi family and decides to return to the past to help Nobita.

movie_doraemon - nobita s earth symphony.title: Doraemon the Movie: Nobita's Earth Symphony
movie_doraemon - nobita s earth symphony.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の地球交響楽
movie_doraemon - nobita s earth symphony.overview: When a malevolent entity intent on eradicating music from the world surfaces, Nobita and his friends must unite with supernatural companions to safeguard the planet.

movie_doraemon - nobita s sky utopia_202.title: Doraemon the Movie: Nobita's Sky Utopia
movie_doraemon - nobita s sky utopia_202.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太と空の理想郷
movie_doraemon - nobita s sky utopia_202.overview: Doraemon, Nobita and his friends go to find Utopia, a perfect land in the sky where everyone lives with happiness, using an airship having a time warp function.

movie_stand by me doraemon 2_2020.title: Stand by Me Doraemon 2
movie_stand by me doraemon 2_2020.original_title: STAND BY ME ドラえもん2
movie_stand by me doraemon 2_2020.overview: Nobita travels to the future to show his beloved grandma his bride, but adult Nobita has fled his own wedding.

movie_stand by me doraemon_2014.title: Stand by Me Doraemon
movie_stand by me doraemon_2014.original_title: STAND BY ME ドラえもん
movie_stand by me doraemon_2014.overview: Sewashi and Doraemon find themselves way back in time and meet Nobita. It is up to Doraemon to take care of Nobita or else he will not return to the present.

movie_doraemon - nobita and the green gi.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Green Giant Legend
movie_doraemon - nobita and the green gi.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太と緑の巨人伝
movie_doraemon - nobita and the green gi.overview: A sapling Nobita discovers is turned into a plant-boy with help from Doraemon, and becomes Earth's only hope at passing judgment from the dryadic aliens of the Green Planet.

movie_doraemon - nobita and the windmast.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Windmasters
movie_doraemon - nobita and the windmast.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太とふしぎ風使い
movie_doraemon - nobita and the windmast.overview: After a typhoon hits Nobita's town, he and Doraemon discover a wind sprite who, with some help from Doraemon's 22nd-century tech, takes them and their friends to a fantastic world of wind and storm people. But the wind sprite, named Fuuko by Nobita, had brought them to her world for a reason, as her peoples' gods are battling, and Suneo might be a key player in their feud.

movie_doraemon - nobita and the castle o.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Castle of the Undersea Devil
movie_doraemon - nobita and the castle o.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の海底鬼岩城
movie_doraemon - nobita and the castle o.overview: Nobita and his friends under the waters of the Pacific Ocean. Gian and Suneo take Doraemon's underwater vehicle and travel through the Atlantic Ocean, trying to find a treasure ship.

movie_doraemon - nobita s chronicle of t.title: Doraemon: Nobita's Chronicle of the Moon Exploration
movie_doraemon - nobita s chronicle of t.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の月面探査記
movie_doraemon - nobita s chronicle of t.overview: After being mocked for believing that rabbits live on the Moon, Nobita uses one of Doraemon’s gadgets to create a hidden lunar kingdom. Accompanied by a mysterious new classmate named Luca, Nobita and his friends travel to the Moon’s far side, where they discover children with extraordinary powers and become drawn into a dangerous conflict that reaches far beyond Earth.

movie_doraemon - the new record of nobit.title: Doraemon: The New Record of Nobita's Spaceblazer
movie_doraemon - the new record of nobit.original_title: 映画ドラえもん 新・のび太の宇宙開拓史
movie_doraemon - the new record of nobit.overview: Nobita finds a passage to a spaceship in another dimension. With their new friends, he and Doraemon fight the cruel leader of an exploited planet.

movie_doraemon - new nobita s great demo.title: Doraemon: New Nobita's Great Demon - Peko and the Exploration Party of Five
movie_doraemon - new nobita s great demo.original_title: 映画ドラえもん 新・のび太の大魔境 ～ペコと5人の探検隊～
movie_doraemon - new nobita s great demo.overview: Nobita is followed by a stray dog on his way home and decides to help it find its original owner with the help of Doraemon. They find out that the dog is actually a prince in its homeland in Africa.

movie_doraemon - nobita s little star wa.title: Doraemon: Nobita's Little Star Wars
movie_doraemon - nobita s little star wa.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の宇宙小戦争
movie_doraemon - nobita s little star wa.overview: As Nobita, Gian, Shizuka, and Suneo are making their own space movie, a fleeing bug-sized alien president makes his way to Earth, and needs the help of the kids and Doraemon to stop an oppressive dictatorship threatening his democracy.

movie_doraemon - nobita and the kingdom.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Kingdom of Clouds
movie_doraemon - nobita and the kingdom.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太と雲の王国
movie_doraemon - nobita and the kingdom.overview: Nobita, after wondering if Heaven truly exists, asks for Doraemon to take him there. When his robot pal suggests that they make their own Heaven, Nobita enlists Shizuka, Gian, and Suneo to help, but a war breaks out between two islands in the clouds that could have terrible environmental consequences if Nobita and Doraemon don't bring peace in time!

movie_doraemon - nobita s secret gadget.title: Doraemon: Nobita's Secret Gadget Museum
movie_doraemon - nobita s secret gadget.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太のひみつ道具博物館
movie_doraemon - nobita s secret gadget.overview: Doraemon and his friends travel to the 22nd century to look for his golden bell, which was stolen by a notorious thief called Kaito DX.

movie_doraemon - nobita and the robot ki.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Robot Kingdom
movie_doraemon - nobita and the robot ki.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太とロボット王国
movie_doraemon - nobita and the robot ki.overview: Nobita, Doraemon, and the rest travel to the far future, on an inhabited planet where humans and robots coexist. The Empress of the Robot Kingdom is plotting to strip the robot inhabitants of their emotions, so it's up to Nobita and his friends to stop the plan, while also helping a robot boy named Poko from getting caught in the middle.

movie_doraemon - nobita and the animal p.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Animal Planet
movie_doraemon - nobita and the animal p.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太とアニマル惑星
movie_doraemon - nobita and the animal p.overview: Nobita and his friends get transported to an animal planet after a mysterious pink fog appears inside his house. They work together with the natives to find the origin of the fog.

movie_doraemon - nobita and the winged b.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Winged Braves
movie_doraemon - nobita and the winged b.original_title: のび太と翼の勇者たち
movie_doraemon - nobita and the winged b.overview: Doraemon and his friends have to rescue the people of Birdopia from the wrongdoing of vengeful former bird troopers before they unleash a wicked ancient dragon.

movie_doraemon - nobita s diary on the c.title: Doraemon: Nobita's Diary on the Creation of the World
movie_doraemon - nobita s diary on the c.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の創世日記
movie_doraemon - nobita s diary on the c.overview: To help him with his summer vacation project, Doraemon gives Nobita a kit which allows him to create a new world. The duo and their friends then go on a journey to witness the evolution of life.

movie_doraemon - nobita s three visionar.title: Doraemon: Nobita's Three Visionary Swordsmen
movie_doraemon - nobita s three visionar.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太と夢幻三剣士
movie_doraemon - nobita s three visionar.overview: Nobita is exhausted from having constant nightmares and pleads Doraemon to arrange a dream machine that will enable him to dream of anything he wishes for. As Nobita dreams of him and his friends in the roles of gallant musketeers, the dream world starts to break down due to a dark force, and Nobita will have to put his fantasy to the test and become a hero, both in the real world and imagined.

movie_doraemon - the record of nobita s.title: Doraemon: The Record of Nobita's Parallel Journey to the West
movie_doraemon - the record of nobita s.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太のパラレル西遊記
movie_doraemon - the record of nobita s.overview: As Nobita, Shizuka, Gian, and Suneo are auditioning for a role in their school's play based on "Journey to the West", the coveted role of Son Goku is hotly contested. After suggesting that the real Great Sage Equal to Heaven should play himself, knowing that the story is only a legend, Nobita and Doraemon go back in time to find their own fake Monkey King, but arrive in present day with the story's demons having taken over the world. The only way for things to go back to normal is for Nobita and pals to reenact the tale...for real!

movie_doraemon - nobita and the galaxy s.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Galaxy Super-express
movie_doraemon - nobita and the galaxy s.original_title: ドラえもん のび太と銀河超特急
movie_doraemon - nobita and the galaxy s.overview: Doraemon went missing for 3 days. But it turns out later that he went to the 22nd century to buy a mystery galactic express train ticket whose destination is a secret until the passengers arrive there and see for themselves.

movie_doraemon - nobita s new dinosaur_2.title: Doraemon: Nobita's New Dinosaur
movie_doraemon - nobita s new dinosaur_2.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の新恐竜
movie_doraemon - nobita s new dinosaur_2.overview: Nobita accidentally finds a fossil dinosaur egg mixed with rocks in the dinosaur fossil exhibition site that he had visited before. He returns it to its original state with the 'time blanket'.

movie_doraemon - nobita and the space he.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Space Heroes
movie_doraemon - nobita and the space he.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の宇宙英雄記
movie_doraemon - nobita and the space he.overview: Nobita and friends decide to make a movie inspired by the space adventures of their heroes, but their fiction turns into a reality.

movie_doraemon - nobita and the knights.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Knights on Dinosaurs
movie_doraemon - nobita and the knights.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太と竜の騎士
movie_doraemon - nobita and the knights.overview: Nobita tries to prove to Doraemon and his friends that dinosaurs are still alive, and, after finding an underground cave, discovers a hollow earth civilization of knights and saurian steeds that Suneo must be rescued from.

movie_doraemon - nobita and the spiral c.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Spiral City
movie_doraemon - nobita and the spiral c.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太のねじ巻き都市冒険記
movie_doraemon - nobita and the spiral c.overview: When Doraemon and Nobita win a tiny planet through a lottery, they make use of a screw to bring several toys to life and create a toy town.

movie_doraemon - nobita drifts in the un.title: Doraemon: Nobita Drifts in the Universe
movie_doraemon - nobita drifts in the un.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の宇宙漂流記
movie_doraemon - nobita drifts in the un.overview: Nobita and his friends embark on a rescue mission to save Gian and Suneo, whom, after playing one of Doraemon's futuristic video games, are held captive by an evil alien force.

movie_doraemon - nobita s new great adve.title: Doraemon: Nobita's New Great Adventure Into the Underworld - The Seven Magic Users
movie_doraemon - nobita s new great adve.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の新魔界大冒険 〜7人の魔法使い〜
movie_doraemon - nobita s new great adve.overview: Nobita wishes the world into a magic-reliant one with Doraemon's Moshimo-Box, and, along with his friends, must stop an asteroid from hitting the planet with help from a sorcerer-in-training.

movie_doraemon - nobita and the birth of.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Birth of Japan
movie_doraemon - nobita and the birth of.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の日本誕生
movie_doraemon - nobita and the birth of.overview: Nobita, thinking of running away from home, travels back in time with Doraemon and his pals to prehistoric Japan. However, a time paradox causes prehistoric boy Kukul to land in the modern day, so it's up to Doraemon and the rest to help the boy get back to the past while also defeating the mysterious shaman king, Giga-Zombie.

movie_doraemon - nobita s great adventur.title: Doraemon: Nobita's Great Adventure in the Antarctic Kachi Kochi
movie_doraemon - nobita s great adventur.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の南極カチコチ大冒険
movie_doraemon - nobita s great adventur.overview: Doraemon and Nobita discover a mysterious golden ring far beneath the ice in Antarctica, leading them to uncover an ancient, ruined city.

movie_doraemon - nobita s dinosaur_1980.title: Doraemon: Nobita's Dinosaur
movie_doraemon - nobita s dinosaur_1980.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の恐竜
movie_doraemon - nobita s dinosaur_1980.overview: When Suneo does not show Nobita the fossil of a dinosaur claw, he takes up a challenge to find a dinosaur. He digs up a hillside and finds an egg, which later hatches and becomes a dinosaur.

movie_doraemon - nobita s treasure islan.title: Doraemon: Nobita's Treasure Island
movie_doraemon - nobita s treasure islan.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の宝島
movie_doraemon - nobita s treasure islan.overview: Upon hearing about the story of Treasure Island, Nobita dreams of discovering and exploring his own treasure island, despite the fact all of the Earth has been mapped already.

movie_doraemon - nobita and the island o.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Island of Miracles – Animal Adventure
movie_doraemon - nobita and the island o.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太と奇跡の島 ～アニマル アドベンチャー～
movie_doraemon - nobita and the island o.overview: Nobita and Doraemon use time tree Mochi and catch a big bird, which has been extinct for 500 years ago. To protect the animal, Nobita and Doraemon go to Beremon Island, overseen by a golden beetle named Herakles.

movie_doraemon - nobita and the legend o.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Legend of the Sun King
movie_doraemon - nobita and the legend o.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の太陽王伝説
movie_doraemon - nobita and the legend o.overview: Doraemon and its friends open a hole in the time and they're travel to the Country of Mayana, a lost Mayan civilization in the jungle.

movie_doraemon - nobita in the wan-nyan.title: Doraemon: Nobita in the Wan-Nyan Spacetime Odyssey
movie_doraemon - nobita in the wan-nyan.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太のワンニャン時空伝
movie_doraemon - nobita in the wan-nyan.overview: Nobita, believing he and Doraemon had done a good deed by saving stray cats and dogs and sending them back in time by 300 million years, discover that the usage of Doraemon's Ray of Evolution had created a cat-and-dog-person society equal to Nobita's time. When an asteroid attack is set to hit the city, Nobita and his friends must save Doraemon and ease tensions between the two sides.

movie_doraemon - nobita s great adventur.title: Doraemon: Nobita's Great Adventure in the South Seas
movie_doraemon - nobita s great adventur.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の南海大冒険
movie_doraemon - nobita s great adventur.overview: Nobita coaxes his friends to join him for a treasure hunt but an eerie event transports them to the past. However, their hunt for treasure is not easy as they come face-to-face with pirates.

movie_doraemon - nobita and the tin laby.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the Tin Labyrinth
movie_doraemon - nobita and the tin laby.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太とブリキの迷宮
movie_doraemon - nobita and the tin laby.overview: Nobita and his friends find a portal to a mysterious resort filled with metal buildings. They soon discover that the person who opened the portal for them has an ulterior motive.

movie_doraemon - nobita s dorabian night.title: Doraemon: Nobita's Dorabian Nights
movie_doraemon - nobita s dorabian night.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太のドラビアンナイト
movie_doraemon - nobita s dorabian night.overview: Shizuka ends up in the fantasy world of the 'Arabian Nights' story. However, Doraemon, Nobita, Suneo, and Jyaian must find her from the imaginary Middle East and bring her back to the real life.

movie_doraemon - nobita and the new stee.title: Doraemon: Nobita and the New Steel Troops: Winged Angels
movie_doraemon - nobita and the new stee.original_title: 映画ドラえもん 新・のび太と鉄人兵団 ～はばたけ 天使たち～
movie_doraemon - nobita and the new stee.overview: Nobita and Doraemon find a giant robot in pieces which they later assemble. It turns out to be a destructive weapon and the gang must save Earth from an imminent invasion.

movie_doraemon - nobita s great battle o.title: Doraemon: Nobita's Great Battle of the Mermaid King
movie_doraemon - nobita s great battle o.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の人魚大海戦
movie_doraemon - nobita s great battle o.overview: Nobita, Doraemon, and the rest must come to the aid of mermaid princess Sophia, whose undersea kingdom is suffering under the weight of a war. Their only hope lies in a mythical sword from the planet Aqua...
